title: Section 9 of the format of 1.618 — Terrain layers
description: Colour of a terrain layer of the planet. Only the format of 1.618 carries this section, at index 9; a later game update removed it.

layerId.description: Id of the layer (e.g. "PC-Toxicity-Layer2"), a free string no pattern describes

colorBase.description: Base color as four numbers separated by dashes ("R-G-B-A")

colorCustom.description: Custom color as four numbers separated by dashes ("R-G-B-A")

colorBaseLerp.description: Base color intensity, no upper bound (101 attested)

colorCustomLerp.description: Custom color intensity, no upper bound
